import socket, struct, fcntl, time

def ifreq(name, flag=0x0001, addr=b'\x00'*14):  # IFF_TAP|IFF_NO_PI
    return struct.pack('16sH14s', name.encode(), flag, addr)

s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
res = fcntl.ioctl(s.fileno(), 0x400454CA, ifreq('tap0'))
print('tap0 created')
s.close()

s2 = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
def ifn(name): return struct.pack('16s', name.encode())
fcntl.ioctl(s2.fileno(), 0x8916, ifn('tap0') + struct.pack('4s', struct.inet_aton('10.0.2.2')))
fcntl.ioctl(s2.fileno(), 0x891C, ifn('tap0') + struct.pack('4s', struct.inet_aton('255.255.255.0')))
fcntl.ioctl(s2.fileno(), 0x8914, ifn('tap0') + struct.pack('H', 0x1909 | 0x8000) + b'\x00'*10)
print('tap0 configured and up')
s2.close()
time.sleep(300)
PYEOF
